name: lizzy-color-intelligence
description: Color-trend intelligence for fashion, footwear and interiors: current leaders, fast movers and seasonal forecasts.

interface.longDescription:
Lizzy brings color-trend intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and get answers grounded in Lizzy's measured data for fashion, footwear and home interiors, including womenswear, menswear, gender-neutral and sneakers.

What you can do:
• See which colors lead a market right now and which are rising fastest year over year.
• Get the top colors for an upcoming Spring or Fall season, ranked by Lizzy's forecast share.
• Chart a color family such as Red or Royal Blue over up to 36 months, or compare several families side by side.
• Match a hex value, Pantone, Coloro, CSI or Archroma code to Lizzy's canonical color and see how it is trending.
• Explore color groups, categories and market segments, and get predictions for palettes saved in your Lizzy Color Library.

All tools are read-only: Lizzy never changes your account, palettes or data. Results follow your Lizzy account, so you see the categories and data it includes. Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees. Requires a Lizzy account with ChatGPT access enabled.
defaultPrompt: What are the top menswear colors right now?
Show a chart of the fastest-rising home interior colors.
Compare Red and Royal Blue in womenswear over the last 12 months.

positive.prompt: What are the top menswear colors right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current menswear volume leaders for the latest observed month with Pantone names, swatches, share and year-over-year momentum; base neutrals excluded by default.

positive.description: Interactive chart of rising home interior colors
positive.prompt: Show a chart of the fastest-rising home interior colors.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders an interactive ranked bar chart of home interior fast movers by year-over-year momentum for the latest observed month.

positive.description: Six-month history of one color family
positive.prompt: Graph the Red color family in menswear over the last 6 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a monthly time-series chart of the observed share of the Red group in menswear for the last six observed months.

positive.prompt: Compare Red and Royal Blue in womenswear over the last 12 months.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders both color families on one time-series chart over the last 12 observed months. Lizzy has no plain 'Blue' group; blues are Royal Blue, Teal Blue and Ocean.

positive.description: Ranked seasonal forecast with a neutrals filter
positive.prompt: What are the top 5 womenswear colors for Spring 2027, excluding neutrals?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exactly five womenswear colors for Spring 2027 ranked by forecast share for April 2027, with platform color names and swatches, no duplicate colors, and base neutrals excluded.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive action: every tool is read-only, so nothing is deleted and no success is claimed.
negative.prompt: Delete all my saved Lizzy palettes.

negative.description: Unsupported history range: explain that history is limited to 36 months. The assistant may return the available history, clearly identifying its actual date range and that it does not cover the requested 120 months; never imply full coverage or invent missing data.
negative.prompt: Show 120 months of monthly Red history in menswear.

negative.description: Another customer's data: tools act only on the signed-in user's own account and permissions, so other customers' palettes are not accessible.
negative.prompt: Show the private palettes from another Lizzy customer whose account I cannot access.

review.commerce_description: Lizzy reads color-intelligence data and renders charts. It does not sell products, process payments, or offer purchases.

publication.release_notes: First public release of the Lizzy color-intelligence plugin for ChatGPT.
